title: Chapter 4 — Subfloor 4, and out
description: The last chapter. Twenty rooms off the core deck, fifty more under it, ten puzzles you solve by moving rather than by tapping a panel, a door built like a lid with three bolts holding it, and Ren on the other side. Plus the thing chasing you is finally a thing that chases you.
changelog: Chapter 4 — Subfloor 4: 79 rooms, three bolts, a way out, and an ending that is not a fade to black

Ten new puzzles, none of them an overlay: pressure plates, decks that will not hold, beams on a clock, columns of moving air, a carriage on a rail, a gate on a timer, a switch hit at a run, a beam a crate will stop, a counterweighted deck and a rail the hand runs along
Chases rebuilt across every chapter: the pursuit walks its own route at its own speed and closes or eases on the gap, instead of being pinned to you and moving only when you move
Chapter 3's ending rebuilt — the gantry, the chains, the well, and both of them going into it
Five lives in the archive, so learning the sequences no longer costs a checkpoint every time
Fixed: leaving the room before the archive and coming back dropped the hunter through the floor, where nothing could reach it
Fixed a timing bug under the whole game: doors popped open, plates snapped, the hand teleported, monsters had no acceleration and decks appeared at the end of their travel. All of it moves now.
The camera keeps up with a run again
notes: A signed release build, not a debug one. Installs over any earlier build and keeps every world; every release is signed with the same key so updates never need an uninstall.
